description: This Java source file defines the PersonVoidHandler class, which handles voiding (deactivating) Person objects within the OpenMRS system by setting specific void-related attributes and retiring associated users. It implements the handle method to perform these operations, ensuring proper voiding behavior for Person entities.

classes.name: PersonVoidHandler
classes.description: The class handles the void operation for Person objects, setting void-related attributes and retiring associated users when a Person is voided.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Performs the void operation on a Person object by setting void attributes and retiring linked users, if the person is not already voided.
